Title: Follow the Horse, Complete the Bingo|(말 따라 빙고 정복)
Results: Mission Accomplished. Through the game of luck, all the members avoided the penalty and received health supplements as a prize.

Title: Gold Bag Chasers: Gold Me More|(금 가방 추격자: 골드 미 모어)
Guest(s): Jung Eun-ji|Kim Nam-joo|Oh Ha-young|Park Cho-rong|Yoon Bo-mi|(Apink)
Teams: Jae-suk Team|(Yoo Jae-suk, Yang Se-chan, Park Cho-rong, Yoon Bo-mi)|Haha Team|(Haha, Song Ji-hyo, Jung Eun-ji, Oh Ha-young)|Jong-kook Team|(Kim Jong-kook, Jee Seok-jin, Ji Ye-eun, Kim Nam-joo)
Mission: Acquire the real gold briefcase and put it on the judgement stand to win the race.
Results: The mission was won by Jae-suk Team. They won the real golds as their prize, which Jae-suk would give it to both Park Cho-rong and Yoon Bo-mi. Through the game of luck, Haha, Song Ji-hyo, Ji Ye-eun, Jung Eun-ji, Kim Nam-joo and Oh Ha-young received the ink sponge penalty.

Title: The Lucky 2026 OT Day|(2026 운수 좋은 OT날)
Teams: Draw the Adjective:|Jae-suk Team|(Yoo Jae-suk, Jee Seok-jin, Haha, Ji Ye-eun)|Jong-kook Team|(Kim Jong-kook, Song Ji-hyo, Yang Se-chan, Kwon Eun-bi)Neck-and-Neck Dice of Luck:|Red Team|(Yoo Jae-suk, Kim Jong-kook, Ji Ye-eun, Kwon Eun-bi)|Blue Team|(Haha, Jee Seok-jin, Song Ji-hyo, Yang Se-chan)
Mission: Correctly guess all 5 face balls from the lucky face lottery to win the race.
Results: The mission was won by Kim Jong-kook and Kwon Eun-bi, after both of them correctly guessed 3 of 5 face balls from the lottery. They received a body cream set as their prize. Haha was exempted from the penalty. Yoo Jae-suk, Jee Seok-jin, Song Ji-hyo, Yang Se-chan and Ji Ye-eun had to make the jewel keychain to avoid bad luck before going home as the penalty.

Title: Starting Today, I’m A Nine-Tailed Fox But…|(오늘부터 구미호입니다만)
Mission: Have the same amount of 9 tails for the entire race to avoid penalty.
Results: The mission was won by Yoo Jae-suk, Jee Seok-jin, Yang Se-chan, Ji Ye-eun and Kim Hye-yoon. They each received a box of fruit set as their prize, which Jee Seok-jin would give his prize to Lomon. Haha, Kim Jong-kook, Song Ji-hyo, and Lomon had to write a book report about foxes from the fox storybooks and read it before going home as the penalty, which will be released on RM's official YouTube channel.|[D]

Title: TV Rating Notice Survival|(연령고지 생존 서바이벌)
Mission: Being the last surviving member to have their concept chosen for the new TV Age Rating Notice.
Results: The mission was won by Yoo Jae-suk as the last surviving member through the whipped cream cannon, after choosing Haha's drawing as the final two drawings, with Yoo Jae-suk later deciding to combine his drawing with Haha's drawing for TV Age Rating Notice filming.
